_comment: Copy to config.json next to your project files. Relative paths are resolved from the folder that holds config.json.

host._comment: face_roi = where the host's face is, as fractions of the frame (x,y = top-left; w,h = size). Used for the motion signal. split_crop_x = left edge (pixels) of the half-frame crop used in split-screen; omit for centre.

_mic_cam: which camera recorded the good microphone audio. Its timeline is the master: trim points and audio_track.m4a come from it.
_reels_cam: which camera the vertical reels (and guest_text.txt for hook picking) are cut from.

encoder._video_codec: h264_videotoolbox = Apple hardware encoder (Mac). On Linux/Windows use "libx264" (slower, CPU).

cuts._comment: speak_threshold = motion must be 40% above the camera's own resting median to count as speaking. min_shot_seconds = shortest shot in the final cut (stage 08).

_intro_outro: mp3 played over black at the start/end. Leave "" to skip.

whisper._comment: API key is read from the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable only.

fonts._comment: font family name as installed on the system (libass looks it up by name). Any bold Hebrew-capable font works.
